name: Group 6 Metals Limited
summary: Group 6 Metals Limited operates as a resources exploration and development company in Tasmania and Europe. The company explores tungsten concentrate. The company also focuses on the mining and processing of ore from the Dolphin Tungsten Mine located on King Island, Tasmania. The company was formerly known as King Island Scheelite Limited and changed its name to Group 6 Metals Limited in November 2021. Group 6 Metals Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is based in King Island, Australia.
